Kettle. tlook was so wide, his soul so big, his mind so broad, and a deep love of humanity so permeated him that his talk, or one might more fittingly say, his discourse, was educating and uplifting. But he was a man of moods, descending from heights of Homeric humour to the depths of a divine despair.

arxiv-2103-02511.creator: Anton Arnold 1∗ , Sjoerd Geevers 2∗ , Ilaria Perugia 2∗ , Dmitry Ponomarev 1,3∗
arxiv-2103-02511.description: Abstract . We introduce a new numerical method for solving time-harmonic acoustic scattering problems. The main focus is on plane waves scattered by smoothly varying material inhomogeneities. The proposed method works for any frequency ω \omega , but is especially efficient for high-frequency problems.

arxiv-2104-04688.title: Converged ab initio calculations of heavy nuclei
arxiv-2104-04688.creator: T. Miyagi, S. R. Stroberg, P. Navrátil, K. Hebeler, J. D. Holt
arxiv-2104-04688.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by T. Miyagi, S. R. Stroberg, P. Navrátil, K. Hebeler, J. D. Holt. We propose a novel storage scheme for three-nucleon (3N) interaction matrix elements relevant for the normal-ordered two-body approximation used extensively in ab initio calculations of atomic nuclei.

arxiv-2308-06622.title: DFM-X: Augmentation by Leveraging Prior Knowledge of Shortcut Learning
arxiv-2308-06622.creator: Shunxin Wang, Christoph Brune, Raymond Veldhuis, Nicola Strisciuglio, University of Twente, The Netherlands
arxiv-2308-06622.description: Abstract Neural networks are prone to learn easy solutions from superficial statistics in the data, namely shortcut learning, which impairs generalization and robustness of models. We propose a data augmentation strategy, named DFM-X, that leverages knowledge about frequency shortcuts, encoded in D ominant F requencies Maps computed for image classification models.

arxiv-2309-11559.title: A Close Look at Ly α \alpha Emitters with JWST/NIRCam at z ≈ 3.1 z\approx 3.1 Facilities: JWST (NIRCam) astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , GALFIT , CIGALE , emcee , matplotlib

arxiv-2309-11559.description: Abstract We study 10 spectroscopically confirmed Ly α \alpha emitters (LAEs) at z ≈ 3.1 z\approx 3.1 in the UDS field, covered by JWST/NIRCam in the PRIMER program. All LAEs are detected in all NIRCam bands from F090W to F444W, corresponding to restframe 2200Å–1.2 μ ​ m \mathrm{\mu m} .

arxiv-2409-08060.title: Super-slowly rotating Ap (ssrAp) stars: Spectroscopic study
arxiv-2409-08060.creator: G. Mathys, D. L. Holdsworth, M. Giarrusso, D. W. Kurtz, G. Catanzaro, F. Leone
arxiv-2409-08060.description: Abstract Context. The fact that the rotation periods of Ap stars span five to six orders of magnitude and that the longest ones reach several hundred years represents one of the main unsolved challenges of stellar physics. Aims. Our goal is to gain better understanding of the occurrence and properties of the longest period Ap stars. Methods.

arxiv-2410-12960.title: Revisiting the hydrodynamic modulation of short surface waves by longer waves
arxiv-2410-12960.creator: Milan Curcic 1,2
arxiv-2410-12960.description: Abstract Hydrodynamic modulation of short ocean surface waves by longer ambient waves significantly influences remote sensing, interpretation of in situ wave measurements, and numerical wave forecasting. This paper revisits the wave crest and action conservation laws and derives steady, nonlinear, analytical solutions for the change of short-wave wavenumber, action, and gravitational acceleration due to the presence of longer waves.

arxiv-2504-07832.title: A character theoretic formula for base size II Thanks: The author thanks Martin Liebeck for a helpful early conversation, and Peter Cameron for his comments on a draft. Research of Coen del Valle is supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [funding reference numbe
arxiv-2504-07832.creator: Coen del Valle
arxiv-2504-07832.description: Abstract . A base for a permutation group G G acting on a set Ω \Omega is a sequence ℬ \mathcal{B} of points of Ω \Omega such that the pointwise stabiliser G ℬ G_{\mathcal{B}} is trivial. The base size of G G is the size of a smallest base for G G .

arxiv-2506-07001.title: Adversarial Paraphrasing: A Universal Attack for Humanizing AI-Generated Text
arxiv-2506-07001.creator: Yize Cheng, Vinu Sankar Sadasivan, Mehrdad Saberi, Shoumik Saha, Soheil Feizi
arxiv-2506-07001.description: Abstract The increasing capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) have raised concerns about their misuse in AI-generated plagiarism and social engineering. While various AI-generated text detectors have been proposed to mitigate these risks, many remain vulnerable to simple evasion techniques such as paraphrasing. However, recent detectors have shown greater robustness against such basic attacks.

arxiv-2509-24324.title: ARITHMETIC PROPERTIES OF PARTITIONS WITH 1-COLORED EVEN PARTS AND r–COLORED ODD PARTS
arxiv-2509-24324.creator: M. P. Thejitha, S. N. Fathima
arxiv-2509-24324.description: Abstract Recently, Hirschhorn and Sellers defined the partition function a r ​ ( n ) a_{r}(n) , which counts the number of partitions of n n wherein even parts come in only one color, while the odd parts may appear in one of r r -colors for fixed r ≥ 1 r\geq 1 .

arxiv-2510-01279.title: TUMIX: Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling with Tool-Use Mixture
arxiv-2510-01279.creator: Yongchao Chen ∗, Jiefeng Chen, Rui Meng, Ji Yin, Na Li, Chuchu Fan, Chi Wang, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon
arxiv-2510-01279.description: Abstract While integrating tools like Code Interpreter and Search has significantly enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning in models like ChatGPT Agent and Gemini-Pro, practical guidance on optimal tool use is lacking. The core challenge is effectively combining textual reasoning, coding, and search for diverse questions.

pmc-10701441.title: Beyond ENO1, emerging roles and targeting strategies of other enolases in cancers
pmc-10701441.creator: Jiaojiao Ni, Yihui Huang, Chaoqun Li, Qian Yin, Jieer Ying
pmc-10701441.description: Aerobic glycolysis is a hallmark property of cancer metabolism. Enolase is a glycolytic enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of 2-phosphoglycerate into phosphoenolpyruvate. In mammals, enolases exist in three isoforms, encoded by the genes ENO1, ENO2, and ENO3. The altered expression of enolases is a common occurrence in various types of cancer.

pmc-11103080.title: Variability between human experts and artificial intelligence in identification of anatomical structures by ultrasound in regional anaesthesia: a framework for evaluation of assistive artificial intelligence
pmc-11103080.creator: James S. Bowness, Robert Morse, Owen Lewis, James Lloyd, David Burckett-St Laurent, Boyne Bellew, Alan J.R. Macfarlane, Amit Pawa, Alasdair Taylor, J. Alison Noble, Helen Higham
pmc-11103080.description: BackgroundScanNavTMAnatomy Peripheral Nerve Block (ScanNav™) is an artificial intelligence (AI)-based device that produces a colour overlay on real-time B-mode ultrasound to highlight key anatomical structures for regional anaesthesia. This study compares consistency of identification of sono-anatomical structures between expert ultrasonographers and ScanNav™.MethodsNineteen experts in ultrasound-guided regional anaesthesia (UGRA) annotated 100 structures in 30 ultrasound videos across six anatomical regions.

pmc-11337139.title: Promoting Health Literacy in the Workplace Among Civil Servants: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11337139.creator: Florence Carrouel, Benjamin du Sartz de Vigneulles, Céline Clément, Virginie-Eve Lvovschi, Elise Verot, Valeria Tantardini, Michel Lamure, Denis Bourgeois, Romain Lan, Claude Dussart, Roy Marzo, Travis Sanchez
pmc-11337139.description: BackgroundIn 2022, the World Health Organization highlighted the alarming state of oral health (OH) worldwide and urged action to include OH in initiatives on noncommunicable diseases. The population needs improved OH skills and attitudes and an adequate level of OH literacy (OHL) and general health literacy (HL).

pmc-11641942.title: Suppressing Interface Defects in Perovskite Solar Cells via Introducing a Plant-Derived Ergothioneine Self-Assembled Monolayer
pmc-11641942.creator: Cheng-Hsien Yeh, Hung-Chieh Hsu, Jung-Che Tsao, Hsuan-Ta Wu, Teh-Pei Lin, Chien-Te Wu, Shih-Hsiung Wu, Chuan-Feng Shih, Fabrice Goubard
pmc-11641942.description: Perovskite solar cells are among the most promising renewable energy devices, and enhancing their stability is crucial for commercialization. This research presents the use of L-Ergothioneine (L-EGT) as a passivation material in perovskite solar cells, strategically placed between the electron transport layer and the perovskite absorber layer to mitigate defect states at the heterojunction interface.

pmc-12482704.title: Profile of pituitary adenoma in patients from rural areas: A study at Dr. Saiful Anwar hospital, Indonesia, 2024
pmc-12482704.creator: Donny Wisnu Wardhana, Farhad Balafif, Tommy Alfandy Nazwar, Fachriy Balafif, Wino Vrieda Vierlia, Iriana Maharani, Rulli Rosandi, Laksmi Sasiarini, Dessika Rahmawati, Yuyun Yueniwati, Harjoedi Adji Tjahjono, Anisa Nur Kholipah
pmc-12482704.description: Background: Pituitary adenoma is a benign tumor that can greatly affect prognosis, with delayed diagnosis posing a significant challenge. In Indonesia, epidemiological data on this tumor remain scarce. This study aims to explore the clinical profile of pituitary adenoma patients treated at Dr. Saiful Anwar General Hospital in 2024.

pmc-12531958.title: Glymphatic system dysfunction in alcohol use disorder: Current understanding and future directions
pmc-12531958.creator: Jia-Yu Lin, Hai-Bo Zhang, Ling Luo, Ren-Jie Li, Xiao-Guang Wang
pmc-12531958.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The glymphatic system, a recently discovered cerebrospinal fluid-mediated pathway, plays a crucial role in fluid exchange and waste clearance in the brain. Its dysfunction has been implicated in various neurological disorders, including Alzheimer’s disease and traumatic brain injury.

pmc-12648322.title: Unveiling Atomic-Level Synergy of Pt3Fe Alloy Nanoparticles and Fe Single Atoms for Enhanced Electrochemical Stability
pmc-12648322.creator: Wen Huang, Jiabao Nie, Zhiying Zheng, Xiaotian Wang, Chunyu Qiu, Xin Li, Zhiyou Zhou, Zhiyao Duan, Yucheng Wang, Shigang Sun
pmc-12648322.description: The hybridization of single atom sites (SASs) and nanoparticles (NPs) demonstrates enhanced stability under acidic electrochemical environments when compared to their individual components; however, the underlying synergistic mechanisms remain elusive. Here we synthesize a hybrid catalyst featuring electron transfer from Pt3Fe NPs to high-spin D1-type FeN4 SASs.

pmc-12745955.title: A multi-pass differential photoacoustic spectrometer at 1064 nm for ambient aerosol absorption
pmc-12745955.creator: Jie Chen, Xianmei Qian, Wenyue Zhu, Qiang Liu, Jianjie Zheng, Tao Yang, Tengfei Yang
pmc-12745955.description: Accurate atmospheric aerosol absorption measurements are critical for advancing our understanding of global climate effects and reginal meteorological processes. In this paper, a multi-pass differential photoacoustic spectrometer (MP-DPAS) worked at 1064 nm, was developed for the in-situ measurement of atmospheric aerosol absorption coefficients (Abs).

pmc-12764006.title: Developing an integrated evaluation indicator system for non-communicable disease management in China’s primary care: a modified Delphi-analytic hierarchy process study based on the structure-process-outcome framework
pmc-12764006.creator: Jiajia Zhang, Yuhan Wu, Rui Tian, Dahai Zhao
pmc-12764006.description: BackgroundThe aging population and increasing prevalence of chronic conditions have led to higher healthcare costs and greater resource utilization globally, exerting considerable pressure on healthcare system sustainability. Integrating services in primary healthcare can improve access and effectiveness for chronic disease management.

pmc-13071286.title: Autograft Augmentation of Patellar Tendon Rupture Allows Better Functional Outcomes and Less Reoperation Than Steel Wire Cerclage
pmc-13071286.creator: Paul Sempere, Romir Patel, Victor Germon, Jean-Noel Argenson, Henri Peuchot, Matthieu Ollivier, Christophe Jacquet
pmc-13071286.description: Background:Patellar tendon rupture is uncommon but can severely impair knee extension and functional recovery. Most injuries occur during sports involving eccentric quadriceps loading, often with valgus stress. Traditional repair using transosseous sutures reinforced with steel wire cerclage provides initial stability but carries drawbacks, including hardware irritation, stiffness related to immobilization, and the frequent need for secondary removal.

pmc-13335481.title: CDW19S coordinates phasic end processing via distinct enzymatic activities
pmc-13335481.creator: Ming Zeng, Zizhi Tang, Chunyi Li, Laifeng Ren, Xiaojun Wang, Antony Carr, Cong Liu
pmc-13335481.description: In response to DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs), 5′-3′ resection is required for production of single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) and commitent of homologous recombination (HR). Here, we demonstrated that CDW19S, a DSB-bound 19S proteasome variant, coordinates phasic control of long-range resection in a spatial-separated manner.

pmc-13391421.title: Factors contributing to low uptake of vaccination in underserved communities: a mixed-method diagnostic design in Southwest Region of Cameroon
pmc-13391421.creator: Edgar Mandeng Ma Linwa, Pamela Oben Besong, Nelson Sontsa Njedock, Jamin Ghangha, Ismail Shifu, Samuel Nkengfua, Martha Ngoe, Michael Ngenge Budzi, Neris Mabou Nfor, Kibu Odette Dzemo, Dickson-Shey Nsagha
pmc-13391421.description: Introductionin Cameroon, the Southwest Region (SWR) has a high zero-dose (ZD) prevalence (31% in 2021), undermining global immunization goals. This region also experiences sociopolitical unrest, which contributes to low vaccination uptake in underserved communities. This study aimed to quantify the prevalence, identify associated factors, explore barriers and facilitators, and elucidate socio-cultural drivers of zero-dose.

pmc-13522205.title: eHealth literacy mediates the relationship between health literacy and concussion attitudes among parents in South Korea
pmc-13522205.creator: Hang A. Park, Ki Ok Ahn, Ju Ok Park, Sola Kim
pmc-13522205.description: BackgroundDigital technologies have become major sources of health information; however, individuals’ ability to integrate such information varies according to their health literacy (HL) and eHealth literacy (e-HL). In concussion management, accurate knowledge and appropriate attitudes are important for symptom recognition and healthcare-seeking behaviors. Nevertheless, the relationships among HL, e-HL, and concussion-related knowledge and attitudes remain poorly understood.
